assertions.description: HTMLAnchorElement exposes the reflected windowFeatures IDL attribute (HTMLHyperlinkElementUtils, RuntimeEnabled=WindowOpenSplitTab).
HTMLAreaElement exposes the reflected windowFeatures IDL attribute.
HTMLFormElement exposes the reflected windowFeatures IDL attribute.
On a, area and form, windowFeatures defaults to the empty string and returns the windowfeatures content attribute verbatim after setAttribute().
Assigning windowFeatures on a, area and form writes the windowfeatures content attribute ([Reflect] setter, not a JS expando).

window.open(url, '', 'split') opens a non-popup (window.locationbar.visible === true in the opened document), while 'split,popup', 'split=0' and 'splitsize=30' alone still yield a popup (locationbar.visible === false).
assertions.test: Needs transient user activation to open windows (popup blocking). Exercise it on the barprop-fallback-matrix concept page: the "split" row must report tab/split on a supporting engine.

assertions.description: window.open(url, '', 'split') returns a WindowProxy whose opener is the caller and which the caller can close(); 'split,noopener' and 'split,noreferrer' return null.
assertions.test: Needs transient user activation to open windows. Exercise it on the live-preview-handle concept page (open, Try split,noopener, Close preview).

assertions.description: Activating <a windowfeatures="split"> with no target opens a new top-level view (implied target="_blank"), while a target naming an existing frame navigates that frame and ignores the features.
assertions.test: Needs a real link activation. Exercise it on the declarative-windowfeatures concept page ("No target attribute" and "Open into the named frame" links).
